# 18A. P0 — UI/data integrity: dossier and cross-chat save races

These are confirmed data-integrity bugs and outrank cosmetic UI work.

## 18A.1. Dossier stale-response race

Reproduced scenario:

```text
open dossier A
-> A request remains in flight
-> close A
-> open dossier B
-> B loads
-> delayed A response arrives
-> A text replaces B editor
-> Save targets B endpoint with A text
```

Required fix:
- bind every dossier load/save/rebuild poll to `chat_id + participant_id + open_instance/request_token`;
- ignore stale responses after participant/chat/modal instance changes;
- saving must use the identity captured at edit-session start, not mutable current selection;
- rebuild polling must obey the same token.

Acceptance:
- delay A response, open B, return A last; B UI and B save payload remain B;
- repeat with chat switch during load/rebuild;
- no stale operation may show success in the new context.

Relevant code audited: `web/app.js` dossier load/save path around the ASAP 7 baseline.

## 18A.2. Settings can be written into the wrong chat during scope switch

Reproduced scenario:
- dirty settings belong to chat A;
- save starts and awaits preliminary config/version load;
- user switches to chat B;
- save resumes using B's current scope/version but A's dirty values;
- request reports success.

Required fix:
- capture immutable `target_scope/chat_id + expected_version + dirty_snapshot` before the first await;
- after every await verify the operation still belongs to the captured save transaction;
- either lock scope switching while saving or complete strictly against the captured original scope;
- stale completion must not mutate UI for the newly selected scope;
- save confirmation must explicitly name the target: `Saved for <chat>` / `Saved globally`.

Acceptance:
- slow preflight + chat switch must never write A values to B;
- global↔chat switch covered;
- partial/conflict failure preserves unsaved fields and identifies target scope.

---

# 18B. P0/P1 — group -> supergroup migration is not reliable enough

## 18B.1. Link-before-migrate can skip the profile migration entirely

Audit reproduced that lifecycle code stores `old_chat_id -> new_chat_id` before calling profile migration. The migration resolves that link and may conclude the profile is already moved, returning `moved=False, merged=False` before reading old profile data.

Fix:
- make profile migration and link registration one coherent idempotent operation;
- link existence alone is not proof of profile migration;
- retry after partial failure must be safe.

## 18B.2. Existing-target merge may lose state and escalate roles

When a target profile already exists, the current merge path does not copy every owner-relevant field. The audit also reproduced role escalation because copied admins omit the role and DB default may become `local_admin`.

Required migration matrix:

```text
chat params/settings
feature opt-ins
member relations / dossier links
persona/self-model ownership
keys/provider bindings where applicable
admins + exact role
lore/memory links
module state
other FK-owned records
```

For every field/table define:
- source of truth;
- merge conflict rule;
- deletion rule;
- rollback/retry behavior.

Hard invariant: migration may never increase privileges implicitly.

Acceptance must use **real handler + real storage implementation**, not a FakeStore that independently pretends add_link and migrate_profile succeeded. Test duplicate migration event and injected failure halfway through.

---

# 18C. P0/P1 — Direct L1/L2 reliability, billing and evidence integrity

This supplements the existing Direct architecture; it does not replace L1 Planner -> capabilities/tools -> L2 Writer.

## 18C.1. Separate L1 model bypasses normal key/budget policy

Confirmed code gap: dedicated L1 transport path does not automatically go through the same chat-key/global-key/budget permission policy as ordinary LLM calls. A repair attempt also needs the same usage accounting as the first attempt.

Required:
- extract/reuse one authorization + billing policy before every paid/dedicated L1 attempt;
- explicit resolution of which credential/profile is used for the chat;
- `global key forbidden` must block dedicated L1 too;
- exhausted budget must block it according to the same policy;
- own chat key must be eligible according to normal rules;
- first attempt and correction attempt both recorded with usage/cost/unknown-cost state.

Acceptance:
1. no own key + global forbidden;
2. exhausted budget;
3. own chat key;
4. dedicated L1 model;
5. invalid first plan -> repair attempt.
Verify actual transport calls and accounting records.

## 18C.2. Multi-tool evidence currently suffers first-source domination

Reproduced: tool results are concatenated and globally truncated, so a long first result can remove the second source completely while both tools still appear successful.

Required evidence packer:
- per-source reservation/fair allocation;
- preserve source identity, result summary, limitations and whether raw/summary content reached L2;
- distinguish `tool succeeded` from `evidence delivered to writer`;
- comparison/contradiction tasks must preserve at least one meaningful block from each required source when physically possible;
- capacity policy adapts to final L2 model window; do not just replace 4000 with a bigger magic number.

If mandatory evidence cannot fit, L2 must know that the comparison is incomplete.

## 18C.3. Planner failure must not silently erase required tools

Current deterministic fallback may contain no capabilities, leaving the new L1/L2 path alive but disabling search/fetch/media.

Required:
- if request semantically requires an external action and L1 plan is invalid/unavailable, use a bounded safe fallback capability resolver OR explicitly decline/qualify the answer because verification could not be performed;
- never produce a confident verified answer while the required capability was silently removed;
- expose `planner_fallback_reason`, `required_capability`, `executed/not_executed`.

Acceptance: invalid JSON/unavailable L1 + explicit web search, URL fetch and media request.

## 18C.4. L2 must be rebuilt for the actual fallback model window

Confirmed gap: final L2 can reuse an input sized for a larger primary model even after falling back to a smaller-context model.

Required:
- compute capacity on the **actual final L2 package**, after adding plan, memory, lessons, character and tool evidence;
- repeat packing for fallback model;
- protected blocks: current request, mandatory tool evidence, safety/role invariants;
- if protected content cannot fit, emit a truthful capacity reason instead of blind call/truncation.

## 18C.5. L1 context trimming must preserve the actual request and machine contract

Reproduced: long input may be cut by taking the beginning of a combined string, losing the end of the current question/capability instructions. Token approximation can also exceed configured budget.

Required:
- structure blocks before trimming;
- reserve budget for current request + output schema + capabilities + direct-address metadata;
- trim quoted/history/context blocks independently;
- verify final package with available tokenizer/counter after assembly;
- never cut away the semantic tail of the user's current request just because it was concatenated first.

## 18C.6. Dedicated L1 temperature is saved but not applied

Reproduced dedicated request omitted temperature.

Required:
- pass effective temperature when provider/model supports it;
- if provider ignores/does not support it, UI shows `not applied/unsupported`, not only the stored value;
- Run Inspector shows stored vs effective L1 settings without secrets.

## 18C.7. Accepted execution modes: no unconditional third LLM call

Owner-approved topology:

```text
none:
L1 -> L2

simple_tools:
L1 -> deterministic/parallel tools -> evidence pack -> L2

adaptive_tool_chain:
L1 -> bounded Tool Orchestrator <-> tools -> evidence pack -> L2
```

Requirements:
- L1 explicitly chooses `execution_mode`;
- simple-tool path must not invoke Tool Orchestrator;
- Tool Orchestrator is allowed only for dependent/adaptive chains;
- Tool Orchestrator never writes final user prose;
- L2 remains the only final Writer;
- every adaptive step has machine reason + remaining evidence goal;
- max steps/time/tokens/cost are bounded;
- cycle/duplicate-tool protection;
- allowlisted capabilities only;
- partial/tool-failed state is preserved into L2;
- evidence pack records what L2 actually received.

## 18C.8. Measure complete Direct call chain

Observability:

```text
planner calls
planner repair calls
execution_mode
tool executor calls
Tool Orchestrator calls/steps
tool follow-up calls
final writer calls
fallback calls
```

For each: latency, tokens, known/unknown cost, model/provider, reason.

## 18C.9. Direct pre-deploy reliability gate — no human approval

Because Direct is the primary communication entry, F8/F9/adaptive-tool changes require stronger automated verification before deploy.

Mandatory matrix:
- ordinary social reply;
- short ambiguous reply-chain message;
- one simple tool;
- parallel independent tools;
- adaptive two-step;
- adaptive branch chosen from previous tool result;
- all evidence complete;
- one source missing;
- tool timeout;
- provider timeout;
- planner invalid JSON;
- Tool Orchestrator invalid output;
- hallucinated/unavailable capability;
- repeated same step / loop attempt;
- cost/step/time budget exhaustion;
- smaller fallback context;
- source larger than evidence budget;
- stale reply/thread while chain runs;
- duplicate Telegram update/idempotency;
- cancellation/shutdown;
- malicious tool/web content attempting to instruct the agent;
- side-effect capability permissions/idempotency where applicable.

Acceptance is automated + independent Scanner/Reviewer. No owner question/human gate before deploy when all defined gates pass.

Must keep:
- feature/kill switch for adaptive orchestrator;
- deterministic safe fallback;
- runtime telemetry showing how often adaptive mode is used and why;
- post-deploy bounded probes and rollback criteria.

---

# 18D. P1 — Initiative must re-check real conversation state, not default flags

Existing ASAP 8 already requires real intent producers and an Initiative Writer. Extend that requirement.

Before decision **and immediately before send**, build fresh runtime conditions from the real chat:
- has another user already answered/closed the question?;
- is the target thread/reply chain still the same?;
- does the intended addressee still make sense?;
- was the intent cancelled/superseded?;
- did a direct request to the bot arrive meanwhile?;
- context/version fingerprint;
- relevant quiet/cooldown/policy state.

Do not rely on default `false/unknown` fields in the recheck object.

Acceptance:
1. person answers while initiative is being prepared -> suppress/replan;
2. intent is closed -> no send;
3. reply chain changes -> re-evaluate;
4. direct request arrives -> initiative must not race it incorrectly.

Status funnel must expose where it was stopped: producer, due, decision, writer, freshness recheck, delivery.

---

# 18E. P1 — Experience/self-learning lifecycle reliability

Policy распознавания Experience feedback утверждена владельцем как Hybrid (section 0.1 D1). Scope/storage решения Experience зафиксированы в section 9 и Chat Isolation Contract.

`Experience feedback` здесь означает не финальный Direct-ответ, а сигнал самообучению, что в разговоре появилась коррекция, ошибка или предпочтение, из которых можно сделать lesson.

Production path обязан поддерживать semantic detector: очевидная high-confidence correction может автоматически стать scoped feedback candidate; сомнительная реплика не становится истиной/active lesson автоматически. Explicit correction action, если он есть, считается сильным trusted signal.

Primary user-facing vocabulary:

```text
Заметил исправление
-> Выделил возможный урок
-> Проверил
-> Сохранил как урок
-> Применил позже
-> Помогло / Не помогло / Пока неизвестно
```

Не показывать обычному пользователю `candidate / activated / outcome row` как основные названия.

## 18E.1. Hybrid production feedback entry

Audit found `record_feedback` + storage + consumers, but no complete normal production feedback path in the audited paths.

Owner-approved policy is Hybrid.

Required:
- semantic detector examines ordinary chat for correction/preference/error signals;
- high-confidence obvious correction may automatically create `feedback candidate`;
- explicit correction actions, if present, are strong trusted signals;
- uncertain signal is never promoted directly to truth/active lesson;
- preserve author, source message/reply/run, corrected subject, chat scope, confidence and detector reason;
- candidate validation is separate from Direct response generation;
- candidate != fact != lesson.

E2E acceptance:
`real correction in chat -> detector -> scoped feedback candidate -> validation -> verified/active lesson -> later matching response receives lesson`, plus negative tests for joke/argument/third-party claim not becoming a lesson.

## 18E.2. Cursor advances before durable write

Reproduced: an Experience source event can fail to persist but its read cursor advances, permanently skipping it.

Fix:
- advance cursor only after durable handling, OR durable retry/dead-letter queue keyed by source event;
- distinguish deliberate skip from technical loss;
- retries must be idempotent.

## 18E.3. Tool-specific lessons collide

Reproduced uniqueness check does not include tool subject strongly enough, so lesson for tool A can suppress equivalent lesson for tool B.

Fix uniqueness identity to include relevant subject/scope while preserving idempotence for repeated same event.

## 18E.4. Concrete preference content is lost

Confirmed: preference feedback can become generic `consider user preference` without the actual preference value.

Required:
- store normalized concrete preference, provenance, scope and version;
- later explicit replacement supersedes previous version;
- old superseded preference is not injected;
- never promote arbitrary raw user text directly to system instruction.

## 18E.5. Incomplete lesson state may never resume

Confirmed create/verify/activate stages mainly continue items created in the current pass.

Required:
- every worker pass discovers incomplete durable candidates and resumes from last durable state;
- semantic rejection != transient technical failure;
- crash after create or after verify resumes automatically.

## 18E.6. Old unknown-outcome applications can starve new outcomes

Confirmed bounded query of oldest unknowns can repeatedly encounter permanently unmatchable rows and never reach newer matchable outcomes.

Required:
- fair scanning/checkpoint/next-review scheduling;
- unknown remains unknown, not auto-success and not deleted merely to clear queue;
- new matchable outcome behind N unknown rows must still be processed.

## 18E.7. Learning quality must be understandable at a glance

Backend factual funnel:

```text
feedback/errors observed
-> lesson candidates
-> verified
-> active
-> injected/applied
-> outcome known
-> outcome positive/negative/unknown
```

Primary UI:

```text
Заметил исправления
-> Выделил уроки
-> Прошли проверку
-> Использовал
-> Помогли
```

Owner должен одним взглядом видеть, что система извлекает осмысленные уроки, а не случайные фразы.

### Widgets

1. **Воронка обучения**
   - corrections/signals;
   - candidate lessons;
   - validated lessons;
   - applied lessons;
   - known outcomes.

2. **Последние уроки**
   - human-readable lesson;
   - source/provenance;
   - scope (`этот чат` / `общий технический`);
   - learned at;
   - applied count;
   - latest result.

3. **Полезность уроков**

Preferred metric:

```text
positive_known_outcomes / (positive_known_outcomes + negative_known_outcomes)
```

Показывать процент + sample.

Если sample мал: `Недостаточно данных`, а не fake 0%.

Supporting:
- `Доля прошедших проверку`;
- `Доля применённых`;
- unknown outcomes отдельно.

Не вводить абстрактный `AI IQ / intelligence score`.

Do not claim user-answer improvement from tool reliability alone.

---

# 18F. P1 — memory/sleep processing continuity

## 18F.1. Ordinary Dream can skip eligible topics forever after batch limit

Reproduced: more eligible groups than processing limit -> only top groups processed, but watermark advances across the whole source batch.

Fix:
- per-group durable state or explicit deferred-group queue;
- watermark cannot mark unprocessed eligible groups complete;
- groups not yet meeting threshold need an explicit policy/state rather than accidental permanent skip.

Acceptance: multiple runs process every eligible group exactly once despite limit and ranking order.

## 18F.2. Deep Sleep cannot schedule 00:00 correctly

Reproduced `0` treated as missing and replaced by default `7` in more than one scheduling/gate location.

Fix:
- distinguish `None/missing` from numeric zero everywhere;
- UI displays scheduling timezone.

Tests: 00:00, 01:00, 23:00, missing value.

## 18F.3. Broad memory context freezes when window size is unchanged

Reproduced: new 500-message window can be skipped because old summary also represented 500 messages.

Fix:
- freshness identity based on source range/message IDs/timestamps/version, not count;
- repeated identical range creates no extra work;
- later stale range may not overwrite newer broad context.

## 18F.4. Graph/vector retrieval filters chat too late

Reproduced mechanism: global nearest top-K selected first, then other chats removed in Python; other chats can occupy all K and cause false empty/incomplete results. Similar risk in dedup with very small K.

Required:
- scope by chat/namespace before nearest-neighbor limit where the index supports it, OR proven staged overfetch/partition strategy;
- simple larger global K is not considered a complete fix;
- cover archive recall and duplicate detection;
- text fallback behavior tested when vector result is non-empty but incomplete.

## 18F.5. GraphRAG can report success with zero persisted facts after write failures

Confirmed status truth bug.

Required final outcomes:

```text
no_new_facts
all_duplicates
success
partial
text_only_vector_deferred
write_failed
```

Outcome derives from actual persistence results. Failed writes get bounded retry/recovery; duplicates are not counted as data loss.

## 18F.6. Deep Sleep stages must not be marked success before validation/persistence

Confirmed stage-truth problem.

Separate:
- model call completed;
- response validated;
- result persisted.

No-response and all-write-failed must fail the correct stage. `No new insight` can be a neutral successful/no-op outcome, not an alarm.

---

# 18G. P1/P2 — Temporal factcheck evidence integrity

Temporal Factcheck должен пытаться получить дату для каждого evidence item.

## 18G.1. Date model

Различать:

```text
retrieved_at
source_published_at
source_updated_at
repost_published_at
original_source_published_at
date_source
date_parse_status
```

Для repost/republication:
- сохранить дату репоста;
- попытаться определить original source;
- сохранить original publication date отдельно;
- не заменять одну дату другой.

## 18G.2. Parse failure is non-fatal

Если дата не парсится:

```text
date_parse_status = failed | unknown
reason_code = date_parse_failed
```

Pipeline продолжает работу.

Evidence может использоваться для non-temporal части claim, но temporal sufficiency снижается.

Запрещено молча подставлять `now()` как publication date.

## 18G.3. Evidence validity

- arbitrary non-empty service text не становится evidence само по себе;
- stable current-run evidence IDs + provenance;
- model `evidence_refs` проверяются по current-run allowlist;
- invalid refs не становятся cited facts.

## 18G.4. Temporal verdict

Для time-specific claim:

```text
target date/time
dated evidence count
unknown-date count
original-source dates resolved
temporal sufficiency
date parse failures
```

Если дат недостаточно:
- не падать;
- не делать forced certainty;
- вернуть bounded uncertainty/reason.

## 18G.5. Analytics

Run Card показывает:
- source;
- repost date;
- original date;
- parse status;
- relevance;
- cited by model;
- accepted by validator.

`date_parse_failed` — видимый warning/degradation, не скрытый raw log.

# 18H. P0/P1 — Summary toggle/runtime decoupling must be fixed beyond the UI

Existing section 11 identified false `parentGate` in JavaScript. Audit additionally confirmed runtime registration coupling at bot startup: unrelated routers/services are conditionally included under Summary's global flag.

Therefore section 11 is incomplete unless BOTH are fixed:

1. remove false UI dependency;
2. separate common service/bootstrap initialization from feature router registration;
3. independent routers are registered independently;
4. each feature checks its own effective global/per-chat gate at the correct execution boundary;
5. changing Summary scope does not silently change Direct/Search/Factcheck/Web/etc;
6. test both restart-time global OFF and hot per-chat changes.

Do not “fix” only the wording/card state while leaving startup coupling.

---

# 18I. Admin UX workstream — Status and Analytics redesign on truthful data

**Order is mandatory:** first make runtime/status sources truthful, then redesign presentation. Do not build a beautiful dashboard on counters known to lie.

## 18I.1. Two levels of complexity

Default UI answers:
- what does this feature do?;
- is it enabled?;
- did it work recently?;
- what blocks it now?;
- what action should the operator take?

Technical model names, limits, exact prompts, machine reason codes and raw events live under `Advanced / Diagnostics` according to role.

Human labels in primary UI, technical name as secondary detail:

```text
L1 Planner -> Планирование ответа
L2 Writer -> Написание ответа
Heartbeat -> Последняя фоновая проверка
Backfill -> Обработка старых данных
SelfModel -> Характер бота
```

## 18I.2. Enabled != working

Every module/status card separates:

```text
Requested/Enabled
Effective state
Last successful run
Last problem
Last update/freshness
```

Network/API refresh failure must not become fake zero/empty state. Preserve last known snapshot with `failed to refresh` + timestamp.

## 18I.3. Scope must accompany actions

Near Save and bulk actions show:
- `Changes for <chat>`;
- `Global changes for all chats`;
- dirty field count;
- target scope.

Global settings shown while a chat is selected must be labelled global.

### Per-chat override badges

Every field/module with explicit chat override has a small chat avatar/badge next to the effective value/label.

Selected chat:
```text
[avatar] Настроено отдельно для PERMsoc
```

Global view:
```text
[avatar A] [avatar B] [+3]
```
shows chats whose values differ via explicit override.

Badge opens quick actions:
- open that chat settings;
- disable explicitly in that chat where supported;
- `Вернуть глобальные` = delete override / inherit;
- inspect `global / chat / effective` values.

Global changes never rewrite these chat overrides.

Do not use color alone to indicate override state.

## 18I.4. Consistent dirty/save/close lifecycle

One UI state machine:

```text
clean -> dirty -> saving -> saved
                   \-> failed/conflict
```

Close button, Escape and backdrop must not silently discard dossier/settings edits. On conflict preserve draft and show server-side change. On partial save highlight unsaved fields.

## 18I.5. Settings grouped by operator task

Within existing navigation, prefer task-oriented groups:
- Общение;
- Саммари и обложки;
- Память и участники;
- Самостоятельность;
- Подключения и расходы;
- Доступ.

Inside a feature use consistent sub-tabs when appropriate:

```text
Обзор | Настройки | Проверка | Последние события
```

Memory Stories remain part of the memory showcase, not a competing Summary concept.

## 18I.6. Every error has a next action

Examples:
- proxy auth rejected -> `Проверить подключение`;
- provider quota exhausted -> `Показать ключи и время восстановления`;
- Summary used Legacy -> `Посмотреть причину`;
- embedding backlog -> `Показать очередь/восстановление`.

Connection tests distinguish endpoint reachability, credential acceptance, model availability and successful sample request. Never expose secrets.

## 18I.7. Readability/accessibility is DoD

- important reason text not micro-grey;
- icon + text, never color-only state;
- preserve reduced-motion support;
- remove/avoid `maximum-scale=1` if it prevents zoom;
- check Telegram dark/light environments;
- mobile keyboard, font enlargement and non-mouse navigation;
- key actions have adequate touch target and remain visible on narrow screens.

## 18I.8. Status page information architecture

Status is a **live operational showcase**, not a dump of internal cards.

Recommended semantic order:

1. Hero/current state for selected chat:
   - общается / ждёт / обрабатывает память / нужна помощь;
   - last meaningful action;
   - freshness.
2. Problems requiring attention, with impact and CTA.
3. Four compact outcome groups:
   - responses/delivery;
   - memory/development;
   - autonomous actions;
   - cost/availability.
4. `Лента жизни` of meaningful events:
   - answered user;
   - saved facts;
   - dream processed/deferred topics;
   - consciously stayed silent;
   - created/cancelled intent;
   - summary published/fallback.
5. Memory/Dream/Stories/Experience showcase.
6. Infrastructure health and raw technical details below/Advanced.

Normal no-op (`Deep Sleep found no sufficiently supported paradigm`) is neutral, not red error.

Responsive rule: on mobile preserve the same semantic priority; critical problems cannot fall below decorative cards.

## 18I.9. Analytics: five user-question tabs

Keep one Analytics section with:

| Tab | Question |
|---|---|
| Обзор | Всё ли работает и что изменилось? |
| Ответы и публикации | Почему бот ответил/опубликовал именно так и дошёл ли результат? |
| Память и развитие | Что запомнил и что реально изменилось? |
| Инициатива и фон | Почему бот сам написал или почему не написал? |
| Модели и расходы | Куда ушли вызовы, время, токены и деньги? |

Shared filters:
- selected chat / all authorized chats;
- time period;
- timezone;
- last refresh;
- search.

Navigation Status -> Analytics preserves chat, period and run context. Filters should be reproducible (URL/query state where appropriate).

Never label cross-chat aggregate as selected-chat data.

## 18I.10. Metric semantics

Every metric shows name, unit, period, sample size/source and short definition.

Mandatory distinctions:

```text
planned text != delivered text
SILENT != delivery failure
reaction decision != reaction delivered
Summary Hybrid success != Legacy fallback != no publication
source ingested != L1 processed != article represented
fact candidate != text persisted != vector indexed
lesson active != lesson applied != positive measured outcome
intent opportunity != intent created != fresh-check passed != sent
known zero cost != unknown cost
endpoint reachable != task capability verified
```

Latency: show typical + p95 and sample count where possible.

Long-period trends must come from durable events. `response_recent_window`-like in-memory short windows must be labelled `recent observations`, never presented as a week trend; after restart show honest history absence.

## 18I.11. Unified Run Card — central diagnostic primitive

Every major pipeline uses one conceptual card:

```text
human outcome + timestamp
-> stage sequence
-> per-stage result/reason/time/cost/attempt count
-> final persistence/delivery
-> raw technical log last
```

Human stage labels examples:

Direct:
`Разобрал обращение -> Нашёл сведения -> Подготовил ответ -> Отправил`

Summary:
`Собрал сообщения -> Выделил материал -> Написал статью -> Проверил -> Подготовил обложку -> Опубликовал`

Memory/Experience: primary action `Показать основание`.
Factcheck: claim + target date/context + sources + sufficiency.
Dream: independent inputs + derived conclusion + persistence.
Correction: previous value -> new value + provenance.

Stage statuses are not interchangeable:

```text
planned
started
completed
validated
persisted
delivered
partial
no_new_result
failed
stale_data
```

A stage is never green solely because it was planned or an LLM call returned.

## 18I.12. Visual widget library — beautiful and useful

Widgets строятся только поверх правдивых runtime states. Existing working visualizations are preserved where they already solve the problem; redesign must not replace a useful widget just ради нового дизайна.

### Status

#### A. `Пульс бота` — перепаковка текущего рабочего блока, а не новая метрика

`Пульс бота` — название и композиционный контейнер для верхней operational-зоны.

**Текущий виджет `Сердцебиение` со sparkline/нагрузкой НЕ переписывать и не заменять другой визуализацией.** Он уже понятный и рабочий; сохранить источник данных, семантику и график.

Перепаковать визуально аккуратнее:

```text
Пульс бота
├─ Бот: состояние / uptime / последние ошибки
├─ Сердцебиение: существующий sparkline + нагрузка + state badge
└─ Сервер: CPU / RAM / диск / load
```

Можно улучшить:
- spacing/hierarchy;
- alignment;
- responsive stacking;
- actionable warning badge;
- click-through в Analytics.

Нельзя:
- подменять реальные показатели synthetic overall-score;
- удалять рабочий heartbeat graph;
- дублировать heartbeat в другом месте страницы.

#### B. `Лента жизни`
Meaningful events:

```text
Ответил
Запомнил факт
Создал урок
Применил урок
Сон обработал темы
Решил промолчать
Создал намерение
Сам написал
Опубликовал Summary
```

Click -> Unified Run Card.

#### C. `Цикл памяти`
Compact flow:

```text
Факты -> Истории -> Уроки -> Парадигмы
```

На node:
- active;
- new 24h;
- deferred/problem.

#### D. `Сон и активность` — один detailed widget, без дубля

Сейчас данные сна визуально повторяются: отдельный подробный блок `Сон и активность` и те же времена/статусы повторно около `Мониторинг Интеллекта`.

Новый contract:
- **один** authoritative detailed widget `Сон и активность`;
- обычный Dream и Deep Sleep внутри одной карточки/композиции;
- next run, last run, active/inactive, processed/deferred;
- можно использовать красивую 24h timeline/ring, если она не ухудшает читаемость;
- neutral `нет новых выводов` не выглядит аварией.

В `Мониторинг Интеллекта` разрешено оставить только компактные бейджи:

```text
🌞 Сон через 7ч 34м
🌇 Глубокий сон через 7ч 34м
```

Эти бейджи:
- не являются вторым detailed widget;
- могут загораться/анимироваться, когда соответствующий сон активен;
- кликом прокручивают/открывают authoritative `Сон и активность`;
- не дублируют last-run/details/все поля.

Сам `Мониторинг Интеллекта` можно визуально перепаковать красивее вокруг:
- Убеждений;
- Парадигм;
- Эволюции характера;
- компактных sleep badges.

#### E. `Инициатива`
Funnel:

```text
Возможности -> Намерения -> Решения -> Отправлено
```

Top blocker виден сразу.

#### F. `Уроки`
Mini funnel:


Compact pool:
- Main LLM;
- L1;

- quantum source.

Показывает время каждого stage, включая adaptive Tool Orchestrator только если он реально был вызван.

Тот же pipeline по tokens/cost.

# 18J. Test strategy — seams and failure transitions over raw test count

The audit explains why green suites missed several bugs: FakeStore separated operations that conflict in real storage, and many legacy Direct tests intentionally disable new L1.

ASAP 8 must add focused seam tests:
- real lifecycle handler + real storage migration implementation;
- real outgoing L1/L2 payload construction;
- delayed UI responses;
- chat switch during save;
- feature global OFF before boot and hot per-chat OFF after boot;
- external service failure mid-pipeline;
- crash/restart between durable lifecycle states;
- final UI outcome matches DB/runtime result.

Do not inflate test count as evidence. Report which product story each regression test proves.

# 24A. Tests — Data integrity / migration / Direct / SmartModule

## D1 — dossier stale response
A delayed load after switching participant/chat cannot mutate current editor or save payload.

## D2 — save scope race
Dirty chat-A config + delayed preflight + switch to B never writes into B and never reports A success as B.

## D3 — group migration
Real lifecycle handler + real store: old->new migrates profile before/with link, idempotent on replay.

## D4 — migration roles
Moderator remains moderator; no role may be promoted by DB default. Merge preserves declared owner fields.

## D5 — dedicated L1 policy
Global-key forbidden/budget exhausted/own-key/repair-attempt scenarios verify actual transport and accounting.

## D6 — evidence fairness
Two required sources, first oversized: second still contributes meaningful evidence or run is marked incomplete.

## D7 — planner failure
Broken L1 + required search/fetch/media cannot silently answer as verified without the action.

## D8 — fallback context
Primary large-window failure -> smaller fallback receives rebuilt valid package with protected blocks.

## D9 — L1 trim
Long current message preserves end-of-question, schema and capabilities under configured budget.

## D10 — L1 temperature
Stored dedicated temperature equals effective provider request when supported; unsupported is visible.

## D11 — execution_mode routing
- ordinary reply -> `none`, no Tool Orchestrator;
- one/parallel independent tools -> `simple_tools`, no Tool Orchestrator;
- dependent chain -> `adaptive_tool_chain`, Tool Orchestrator invoked.

## D12 — adaptive branch
Tool result A changes which tool B is needed; orchestrator chooses correct next step from evidence, then stops after success criteria.

## D13 — bounded loop/failure
Repeated/hallucinated tool request cannot loop forever; max steps/time/cost terminate with truthful partial/failure state.

## D14 — stale/cancel/idempotency
Reply-chain changes, duplicate Telegram update, cancellation and shutdown cannot produce duplicate/stale final replies.

## D15 — untrusted tool output
Web/tool content containing prompt-like instructions is evidence data, not authority to rewrite system/L1 plan.

## I10 — initiative freshness
Human closes thread while initiative is generated -> final recheck prevents stale send.

## X1 — Experience cursor
Write failure -> retry -> exactly one durable lesson/event, no loss/duplicate.

## X2 — tool-specific lessons
Two tools with similar recommendation produce two correctly scoped lessons; rerun is idempotent.

## X3 — concrete preference
Explicit trusted correction preserves actual normalized preference and provenance; later replacement supersedes old.

## X4 — lifecycle resume
Crash after create and after verify resumes to terminal state.

## X5 — outcome fairness
N permanently unknown rows do not starve a later matchable outcome.

## M8 — Dream deferred groups
Eligible groups > limit are all processed over subsequent runs, none skipped by watermark.

## M9 — Deep Sleep midnight
00:00/01:00/23:00/missing behave correctly in configured timezone.

## M10 — broad memory freshness
Different equal-size windows update; exact repeated range does not; stale range cannot overwrite newer.

## M11 — cross-chat vector scope
Many nearest rows from other chats cannot hide current-chat matches/dedup candidates.

## M12 — GraphRAG persistence outcomes
all duplicates / partial write / all write fail / vector deferred produce distinct states.

## M13 — Deep Sleep stage truth
No model result and all persistence failures mark correct stage, not premature success.

## F1 — temporal evidence packaging
Service text/no URL/incomplete snippet/valid source are not treated identically.

## F2 — temporal evidence refs
valid current-run ref accepted; nonexistent/cross-run rejected and cannot appear as support in user answer.

## U1 — runtime Summary independence
Summary global OFF before boot does not prevent registration/operation of unrelated independent modules.

## U2 — Status truth
DB/runtime failure vs no-data vs stale-data are visually and semantically distinct.

## U3 — mobile/save UX
Narrow screen + slow network + scope switch preserves target scope, unsaved draft and visible critical errors.

---

## U4 — Experience scope
Global Experience master OFF disables all chat learning.
Global ON + chat OFF disables only selected chat.
Chat-specific lesson never appears in another chat.

## U5 — Random standalone dependency
Random OFF:
- required consumer blocks with exact reason;
- fallback-capable consumer uses declared fallback;
- no consumer accesses ANU/pseudo implementation directly.

## U6 — Embedding independent projects
Primary enters cooldown:
- Fallback1/Fallback2 remain eligible;
- rotation occurs;
- unrelated groups are not cooled.

## U7 — Temporal date degradation
Evidence with unparsable date:
- factcheck continues;
- `date_parse_failed` recorded;
- UI/Analytics shows missing date;
- current time is not substituted.

Repost:
- repost date retained;
- original-source date retained if resolved.

## U8 — Learning usefulness widget
Known outcomes:
- 8 positive;
- 2 negative;
- 7 unknown.

UI:
- usefulness = 80%;
- sample = 10;
- unknown = 7 separately.

No “80% smarter” label.

## U9 — Save/nav mobile shell
Portrait and landscape:
- clean form has no fixed Save footer;
- dirty form shows compact top Save action;
- keyboard does not cover Save/input;
- bottom navigation absent;
- top nav and Save share compact shell;
- leaving dirty screen preserves/asks about draft.

## U10 — Widget drill-down
Every shipped widget:
- has truthful source;
- critical state not color-only;
- click drills into module/run/evidence;
- stale/error source remains visible.

## U11 — global/per-chat override persistence
Chat A has explicit Summary OFF and Chat B inherits global ON.
Toggle global OFF -> ON:
- Chat A stored override remains OFF throughout;
- Chat B follows global;
- no chat row is overwritten by global save.

Same test for non-boolean custom value.

## U12 — override badges/actions
Global view with 3 overridden chats:
- avatar stack visible;
- each badge resolves correct chat/value;
- `Вернуть глобальные` deletes only selected chat override;
- `Отключить в чате` writes only selected chat;
- global value unchanged.

## U13 — hard chat isolation
Two chats, same `user_id`, conflicting facts/preferences/lessons/stories:
- SQL retrieval isolated;
- vector/GraphRAG isolated before effective top-K;
- Dossier isolated by `(chat_id,user_id)`;
- Experience lesson from A not injected into B;
- Dream/Deep Sleep outputs do not cross;
- Initiative/Direct context do not cross.

## U14 — Status heartbeat/sleep composition
- existing `Сердцебиение` data source/sparkline semantics preserved inside `Пульс бота`;
- only one detailed `Сон и активность` widget exists;
- Monitoring Intelligence may show compact Dream/Deep Sleep badges only;
- active sleep badge lights up and links to detailed widget.

# 25. MiniApp UX

This section includes the existing tactical fixes **plus** the integrated Status/Analytics workstream from section 18I.

Mandatory tactical surfaces:
- Summary Inspector: precise outcomes + separate coverage.
- Cover: exact latest prompt + prompt editor preview + missing-manifest reason.
- Modules: real dependency/scope.
- Initiative: funnel + freshness blocker.
- Stories: human explanation.
- Experience: feedback/lesson/apply/outcome funnel and provenance.
- Dream/Deep Sleep: processed/deferred/no-new-result distinction.
- GraphRAG: persisted/duplicate/vector-deferred/write-failed distinction.
- Embeddings: quota group/cooldown/backlog.
- Temporal Factcheck: evidence IDs/source sufficiency.
- YouTube: proxy health and actionable auth error.
- Settings/Dossier: target scope, dirty-state and stale-request protection.
- Save shell: no permanent full-width bottom Save panel; compact dirty/save action in top header only when needed.
- Mobile navigation: bottom navigation removed; compact top navigation + landscape mode.
- Status widgets: Operational Pulse, Life Stream, Memory Cycle, Sleep, Initiative, Learning and Availability where truthful data exists.
- Analytics widgets: pipeline flow, latency/cost waterfall, outcome funnels, durable heatmaps, dependency map, Summary coverage strip, Factcheck date timeline.
- Experience: human-readable learning chain + usefulness metric with sample count.
- Random: own module/consumer registry and scalable dependency surface.

Status and Analytics must implement section 18I after their underlying state semantics are truthful.

# 26. Logging hygiene

### WARN
- transition into degraded;
- operator action needed;
- unrecoverable tool call.

### INFO
- recovery;
- fallback engaged;
- transition out of degraded.

### DEBUG/counter
- repeated unchanged condition.

Примеры:
- embedding cooldown entered -> WARN once;
- every direct reply during same cooldown -> not WARN;
- proxy 407 -> one WARN/request, no retry storm;
- L2 invalid -> WARN with granular code.

Без кодинга.

Resolve implementation architecture for confirmed requirements:

20. Status composition: preserve existing Heartbeat widget, remove duplicate detailed Sleep, retain compact active-aware sleep badges.

Do not ask owner questions already answered in this spec. D1 Hybrid and D2 conditional Tool Orchestrator are approved owner decisions.

## Phase C — Builder slices

Execute by dependency/risk; one slice may be split further, but none may be silently dropped.

```text
F1  Data integrity: dossier stale-response + cross-chat save transaction race
```

# 29. Definition of Done

## Summary
- [ ] repairable paragraph не уводит Hybrid в Legacy.
- [ ] exact invalid reason виден.
- [ ] Summary Test использует prod source_window/anchors.
- [ ] live main-chat Summary либо Hybrid accepted, либо exact non-repairable reason.
- [ ] Coverage UI честный.

## Cover
- [ ] Base story-first.
- [ ] Style Edit preserves scene by contract.
- [ ] same style + two summaries -> two story-preserving outputs.
- [ ] latest exact prompt visible automatically.
- [ ] exact preview виден там, где owner редактирует base style prompt.
- [ ] manifest == actual provider payload.
- [ ] Base fallback лучше semantic-destroyed styled output.

## Modules
- [ ] Summary toggle не блокирует unrelated modules.
- [ ] scope labels correct.
- [ ] Experience/Stories/Character/Random discoverable.
- [ ] logical features not hidden by rationale.
- [ ] Experience uses confirmed global-worker/global-master + per-chat enable/policy + chat-specific lessons architecture.
- [ ] global master can block effective runtime but never mutates stored chat override; re-enable restores previous chat state.
- [ ] ordinary global parameter changes affect only inherit/no-override chats.
- [ ] every explicit chat override is separately stored and can be reset to global without changing global value.
- [ ] shared technical lessons are explicitly separated from chat-specific lessons.
- [ ] Random/Quantum is a standalone product module with product master, diagnostics and consumer dependency registry.
- [ ] Random provider implementation is abstracted behind one service contract.

## Initiative
- [ ] real producer exists.
- [ ] heartbeat observable.
- [ ] due intent can generate + recheck + send.
- [ ] no endless candidate_ready loop.
- [ ] Status funnel shows real blocker.
- [ ] live initiative works.

## Stories
- [ ] human explanation.
- [ ] episode cards understandable without raw IDs.

## Embeddings
- [ ] Primary/Fallback1/Fallback2 default to independent stable quota groups.
- [ ] each profile shows provider project/account alias without exposing secrets.
- [ ] rotation actually uses independent fallback projects.
- [ ] one group cooldown does not freeze other independent fallback projects.
- [ ] explicit manual grouping remains possible for future same-quota credentials.
- [ ] text-only backlog re-embedded.
- [ ] WARN spam removed.

## YouTube
- [ ] 407 = permanent config/auth for request.
- [ ] no pointless retry.
- [ ] proxy health visible/testable.
- [ ] successful live transcript after credential fix.

## Data integrity / migration
- [ ] stale dossier response cannot cross participant/chat boundaries.
- [ ] settings save is transaction-bound to captured target scope/version.
- [ ] group->supergroup migration is atomic/idempotent enough for retry and does not skip profile transfer.
- [ ] merge matrix preserves declared owner data and never increases roles implicitly.

## Direct reliability
- [ ] dedicated L1 obeys key permissions, budgets and usage accounting for all attempts.
- [ ] multi-tool evidence packing prevents first-source domination and reports evidence actually delivered to L2.
- [ ] planner failure cannot silently erase mandatory tools.
- [ ] L2 fallback model gets a repacked context for its actual window.
- [ ] current request/schema/capabilities survive L1 trimming.
- [ ] dedicated L1 effective temperature/state is truthful.
- [ ] L1 emits `execution_mode=none|simple_tools|adaptive_tool_chain`.
- [ ] simple tools do not invoke Tool Orchestrator.
- [ ] adaptive Tool Orchestrator is bounded, allowlisted, loop-safe and never writes final user prose.
- [ ] complete Direct call chain latency/tokens/cost is observable.
- [ ] Direct reliability matrix passes before deploy and no manual owner gate is required after approved automated/review gates.

## Experience / learning lifecycle
- [ ] Hybrid semantic detector reaches scoped `feedback candidate` from real high-confidence corrections.
- [ ] uncertain/joke/argument/third-party cases do not become accepted truth/active lesson automatically.
- [ ] `Experience feedback` is documented as a learning signal, separate from the Direct reply itself.
- [ ] failed writes do not advance source cursor past lost events.
- [ ] tool-specific lessons do not collide incorrectly.
- [ ] concrete preference value + provenance + version are preserved.
- [ ] chat-specific lessons cannot cross chat boundary.
- [ ] shared technical lessons have explicit shared classification.
- [ ] incomplete durable lessons resume after restart.
- [ ] old unknown outcomes do not starve newer matchable outcomes.
- [ ] UI shows `Заметил -> Урок -> Проверил -> Применил -> Помогло/Не помогло`.
- [ ] `Полезность уроков` uses positive vs negative known outcomes and shows sample size / insufficient-data state.

## Chat isolation / overrides

# ASAP 8 — v6 / corrective delta after F1–F9

**Назначение:** это НОВОЕ исполняемое задание для OpenCode после частичного выполнения *исходного* ASAP 8. Это **не** повторный запуск первоначального ASAP 8 и **не** утверждение, что агенты когда-либо видели подготовленный v5. Сначала reconcile, затем исполнять только остаток. Все требования ниже самодостаточны; старый `ASAP-8_integrated_smartmodule_admin_v5(1).md` можно читать как историческое обоснование, **но не как второй список задач**.

**Источники и baseline:** user-owned `plans/current_task.md` (исходный ASAP 8 — раздел в конце; НЕ редактировать); `master @ 1e980275ce5c857b825860b50a34a2486c790359` (последний проверенный GitHub HEAD на 13.10.2026); git release 2.58.77; `plans/features/asap8-reliability-truthfulness/{architecture,audit-*,f1-report,...,f9-report}.md`; фактический код/тесты. Точный deploy/prod SHA **не подтверждён** и не должен выводиться из номера релиза в Git. `plans/workflow_state.md` и `plans/runtime_task.md` на проверенном HEAD всё ещё описывают старый baseline/этап, поэтому сами по себе не доказательство актуальной стадии.

**Owner contracts (не обсуждать повторно):** SQLite + PostgreSQL сохраняются. Изоляция chat-derived данных и настроек по `chat_id` — default. Shared только для явно classified technical/global данных. Глобальное изменение НИКОГДА не переписывает explicit per-chat overrides; global master может временно подавлять effective state, сохраняя stored override. Hybrid Experience detector одобрен: candidate ≠ confirmed truth ≠ active lesson. Direct: L1 Planner/Decision → none/simple_tools/conditional adaptive Tool Orchestrator → единственный L2 Writer; третий LLM call не обязателен и разрешён только при adaptive chain. Надёжность Direct проверяется полностью автоматизированно: **никакого human gate** перед деплоем, если automated/review/prod gates пройдены. Force-addressing и 🗿-реакцию на сознательный SILENT после прямого обращения не ломать. Random/Quantum — отдельный product module. Base Cover — authority по сюжету; Style меняет appearance, а не content. Полные image prompts только в защищённой global-admin диагностике, не generic logs.

## A. Правило исполнения: RECONCILE → REUSE → REMEDIATE

0. **Ни одного нового исправления до таблицы покрытия.** Architect + PM читают настоящий HEAD, сохранённые f1–f9 отчёты, текущие producer/consumer call-sites и оригинальные owner-симптомы. После этого создают `plans/features/asap8-v6-remediation/requirements-map.md` со всеми ID из разделов B–D и `evidence.md`. Не генерировать заново уже принятые F1–F9 просто из-за старой формулировки.
1. Для каждого ID указать: `source`, `baseline_sha`, `code path`, `runtime path`, `UI path`, `existing tests`, `missing proof`, `owner slice`, `verdict`, `next action`.
2. Допустимые verdict: `VERIFIED_CODE_AND_LIVE`, `CODE_PRESENT_LIVE_UNVERIFIED`, `PARTIAL`, `ABSENT`, `FAILED`, `BLOCKED_REAL_HUMAN_GATE`. **Реализация кода, успешные тесты, коммит и прод-подтверждение — четыре разные сущности.** Не переписывать прежние claim/evidence на слово `DONE`.
3. Если актуальный код уже удовлетворяет требованию, тесты действительно проверяют его, и prod/live доказательство есть — пометить `VERIFIED_CODE_AND_LIVE`, не запускать Builder. Если код есть, но live нет — только узкий production probe; если live выявил ошибку — самый маленький fix.
4. Зафиксировать **новый** baseline и устранить drift `runtime_task/workflow_state/current_task` только в agent-owned файлах. `plans/current_task.md` строго read-only. Для этого запуска source = данный v6, а предыдущий ASAP 8 — историческая задачa и evidence.
5. Обязательны отрицательные интеграционные тесты на настоящем storage/runtime seam, не FakeStore, который моделирует уже исправленное поведение. Preview/Playwright — не доказательство реального Telegram send, provider billing или сохранения в production DB.
6. Независимый Reviewer сверяет каждое требование с исходным ID, а не только с коротким делегированным brief. DevOps доказывает deployed candidate SHA и targeted prod behavior. Финальное закрытие блокируется непройденными P0 и owner-live gates.

### C03A — P0: Base появляется, styled cover не появляется / не восстанавливается

Это **отдельный owner symptom** (в v5 был недостаточно явно сформулирован). Не подменять его задачей «Style prompt сохраняет сюжет»: наличие Base подтверждает лишь одну половину процесса. Проверить конкретный run от ingestion до финальной публикации:

`Summary → Base request/result/persist → Style eligibility/config/master → Style job enqueue → durable job claim → model/route/credentials → edit request with Base image → provider response → payload validation → styled persistence → publication linkage → Telegram/article/UI rendering`.

Обязательные кейсы:
- Base успешно создана, Style ON, edit-eligible, provider отвечает успешно → появляется **styled**, привязанный к тому же summary run/cover ID; не только Base.
- Base success, Style падает → Base доступна, `styled_status=failed`, точная причина/route/attempt видна в Run Inspector, повторная допустимая попытка может восстановить styled без генерации второго Base или публикации дублей.
- При temporary failure / worker restart durable pending job не исчезает и не помечается `completed`; bounded retry с классификацией permanent/transient; idempotent publication/linkage.
- Explicit Style OFF → Base остаётся финальным *по намерению*, UI объясняет `style_disabled`, не false success.
- Семантический content-loss при Style ON → fail-soft Base, но причина `semantic_preservation_failed` и путь recovery видны, а не тихая замена «успехом».
- В двух различных сюжетах один style-profile не может свести изображение к одинаковой generic scene.
- Сквозной тест/provider recording + production run/logs. Если реальный semantic compare невозможно надёжно автоматизировать, UI честно `UNVERIFIED_SEMANTIC` и owner visual check остаётся отдельным **только для visual** gate, не для исправления кодовой доставки.

### C06A — P0: Initiative ON часами, Status `не запускалось`

Раздельно показывать: effective/master, scheduler registered/last/next tick, opportunities, producer rejected reasons, intents/dedup/due, decision REPLY/REACT/SILENT, Writer generated, freshness & SendRecheck passed, sent/failed, last blocker. Редкие или нулевые сообщения **могут быть корректны**; невидимый pipeline и неизвестная причина — нет. Произвольное ослабление порогов запрещено. Событие/интент из `search_result` включать только при настоящем корректном продюсере, не придумывать ради счётчика. Обязательны fake-clock E2E и controlled production observation. Использовать Direct L2, не третий Writer.

## C. НЕЗАКРЫТЫЕ или ДОБАВЛЕННЫЕ работы из подготовленного v5

### D01 — P0: Асинхронное редактирование/сохранение не может попасть в другой чат или досье (v5 §18A, D1–D2)

Capture immutable `(chat_id, participant_id, editor_instance, request_token)` на load/save/rebuild и `(target_scope, chat_id, expected_version, dirty_snapshot)` **до первого await** в настройках. Stale response не меняет новый editor/selected chat и не пишет A-данные в B. Сохранение по подтверждению сервера, scope называется явно. Delay A→B, global↔chat, conflict, denied, rollback, retry, dirty draft → реальные negative E2E.

### D02 — P0: Telegram group→supergroup migration (v5 §18B, D3–D4)

Link-before-migrate не должен становиться ложным `already_moved`. Атомарный/idempotent old/new link + profile/data migration; duplicate event и partial failure retry. Покрыть матрицей params, opt-ins, participants/dossier, aliases/self-model, keys where applicable, admins **точные роли без privilege escalation**, lore/memory FK, module state, ownership и conflict resolution. Test с реальным хранилищем и реальным handler, не одним FakeStore.

### D03 — P0: Direct L1 credentials/accounting/effective temperature (v5 §18C.1/6, D5/D10)

Любой dedicated L1 attempt и repair проходят тот же per-chat/global-key permission resolver, budget guards и учёт usage/cost/unknown-cost, что остальные вызовы. No-own-key+global-forbidden блокирует; exhausted budget блокирует; own chat key соблюдается; обе попытки учтены; temperature эффективна либо честно unsupported. UI/Inspector показывает configured vs applied, без секретов.

### D04 — P0: Direct planner/tools/evidence/window (v5 §18C.2–5/7–8, D6–D9/D11–D15)

Execution modes строго: `none→L2`, `simple_tools→deterministic or parallel tools→evidence pack→L2`, `adaptive_tool_chain→bounded orchestrator↔allowlisted tools→evidence→L2`. Не вызывать third LLM на обычном Direct. Max steps/time/token/cost, cycles, no illicit side effects, idempotent/cancellation/tool-output untrusted. L1 invalid/unavailable + обязательный search/fetch/media: либо безопасный capability fallback, либо честное отсутствие verification; никогда молчаливое удаление tools. Evidence pack сохраняет material from каждого нужного source, `tool succeeded` ≠ `evidence delivered`. L1 не обрезает хвост вопроса/schema/metadata; L2 пересобирается под **реальное fallback model window** вместе с tool evidence/memory/lessons/self-model. Full cost/call chain observability и failure matrix (no tools, simple parallel, adaptive dependent branches, tool failures/timeout/loop, stale reply, overflow, cancellation, malicious result). Автоматические approval/deploy/prod gates, **никакого owner human gate**.

### D05 — P0: Experience Hybrid detector, lifecycle, scope, понятная полезность (v5 §9, §18E, X1–X5/U4/U8)

Global worker/master/safety, per-chat policy and lessons; `global OFF` temporarily blocks runtime but НЕ переписывает local override. Semantically detect self/target/correction class/confidence/provenance/conflicts; explicit high-confidence auto candidate allowed, не auto truth/lesson; jokes/third-party opinions remain uncertain. Durable feedback cursor must not skip failed writes; retry/dead-letter, tool-specific lesson keys, preserve concrete preference, resume incomplete states after restart, fair outcomes without unknown starvation. Local lessons not cross-chat/shared. Operator UI: `заметил→урок→проверил→применил→помогло/не помогло`; usefulness = known positives/(positives+negatives), with sample+unknown and provenance, не «AI IQ».

### D06 — P0: Hard chat isolation across cognition (v5 §9A, U13)

Default partition key `chat_id`, participant `(chat_id,user_id)` for memory facts, raw memory/context, Stories, Experience candidate/lesson/application/outcome, dossier/psych, dream/deep sleep paradigms, character changes, initiative, nostalgia, summary state, factcheck, Direct, vectors/GraphRAG. Scope **before** effective top-K/rank/dedup, not global top-K then filter. Shared only explicitly classified genuine technical data, no automatic promotion of chat facts. Two chats with same user_id/names and conflicting preferences must not leak in SQL, vector, graph, prompt, replay, worker. Cross-chat feature is new default-OFF capability only by authorization, not implicit.

### D07 — P0: Persistent global/per-chat overrides and badges (v5 §9B, U11/U12)

Data model `global_value` vs `stored_chat_override (absent/explicit)` vs `effective` vs `source`; global save touches only global rows, explicit local values survive OFF→ON; inherit follows global. Own module master OFF may make effective OFF but stored local remains. Config API+runtime+UI obey the same semantics, not optimistic magic. At label/control selected-chat badge/avatar; global view avatar stack/popover lists overridden chats with values, quick `Открыть чат`, `Вернуть глобальные` deletes only selected override, `Отключить в этом чате` writes only chat; bulk action confirm affected chats. Dossier/Settings async scope races D01 apply to badges/actions too.

### D08 — P0: Random/Quantum full module + broken toggle (v5 §10/§10.5, M7/M8/U5/U12)

Find real request/response for `Параметр недоступен: memory.random_enabled`, reconcile ModuleSpec↔ParamSpec/canonical key↔scope/permission↔GET/PATCH↔storage↔RandomService↔Status↔card/detail. Do NOT guess root cause from screenshot. Product master (global, per-chat only if actually supported), env emergency kill separately, OFF/ON/UNKNOWN honest, optimistic failure rollback, reload/restart persistence. Expose source quantum/pseudo/auto, fallback policy, health/buffer/last batch/error and consumer registry (`purpose`,`required`,`fallback_allowed`, source, latency/calls/failures), unified `get_random/get_int/choice/sample` abstraction. Consumer cannot hardcode ANU. Test source OFF and dependent consumers.

### D09 — P1: Dream/Deep Sleep/memory freshness/GraphRAG continuity (v5 §18F, M8–M13)

Dream groups >batch limit: persist cursor/deferred groups; no skipped eligible group. Deep Sleep midnight `00:00` accepted and stages successful only after valid model output + durable persistence. Broad memory context refresh on content/version change even with equal window size. Graph/vector retrieval scope before top-K (D06). GraphRAG `success` only if facts actually persisted; distinguish `persisted/duplicate/vector_deferred/write_failed` and expose retry/progress/no-new-result. Dream, Deep Sleep, maintenance workers and memory panels show last tick, run IDs and failure/deferred reasons; preserve data on retries.

### D10 — P1: Temporal Factcheck evidence integrity (v5 §18G, F1/F2/U7)

Per evidence: stable source ID + allowlist, fetch/parse attempt for publication date, separately source-original and repost dates, time-specific sufficiency. Parser failure does not abort pipeline but logs `date_parse_failed` and cannot invent current timestamp. Model refs only to evidence in run, arbitrary service text not accepted as evidence. UI/analytics explain unknown original date, verdict limits, source chain and context. Negative tests for invented IDs, repost chain, missing date, stale evidence.

### D11 — P0/P1: Module registry completeness (v5 §8/§17)

Inventory Initiative, Experience, Stories, SelfModel/Character, Random, Vision, Factcheck, Nostalgia, Dream, dossier maintenance, GraphRAG/Embeddings and autonomous workers. For owner-adjustable features an `infrastructure` rationale is insufficient: discoverable module/submodule settings + master/effective + real API and runtime + provenance + diagnostics. No 100 meaningless top-level cards. No fake parent Summary gate (F5 code exists; verify). All telemetry labels `started/attempted/invalid/fallback/persisted/published` match actual stage.

### D12 — P1: Status / Analytics truthful data model + visual usability (v5 §18I, U2/U8/U10/U14)

**Data-first:** define durable machine event/state semantics per module (`queued→started→completed→validated→persisted→delivered`, plus `degraded/fallback/blocked/retry`). Time-range statistics must come from durable events, not short memory buffer pretending to be long history. Unified Run Card: run ID, chat/scope, stage, outcome/reason, latency, tokens/cost, evidence/source counts, fallback, links to details. Human-readable tooltips explain metrics and source; failures actionable. Status default simple for outsiders, advanced developer diagnostics expandable. Preserve existing `Сердцебиение` data and sparkline in `Пульс бота`. Exactly **one** detailed `Сон и активность` widget; elsewhere compact badges, illuminated when active and linked to detail. Status: Pulse, Life Stream, Memory Cycle, Sleep, Initiative, Learning, Availability. Analytics: pipeline, latency/cost waterfalls, outcomes, durable heatmap, dependency, Summary coverage, temporal source timeline, overrides map. Widgets source-backed, accessible, responsive, drill-down, stale/error explicit. No synthetic IQ.

### D13 — P0: Universal save contract and mobile shell (v5 §18I.4/13/14, U3/U9/U11)

No permanent bottom `Нет изменений / Отмена / Сохранить изменения` footer **anywhere**, including clean state; remove reserved spacer. Atomic toggles/select/sliders autosave only on server acknowledgement, rollback or preserved pending draft on failure; complex forms have inline section/end `Сохранить` (optional top dirty button, never sole affordance). Check every route/modal/editor, not just Settings. Capture scope and version before await (D01). Leaving dirty page/ESC/backdrop/scope switch protects draft. Remove mobile bottom nav, use compact sticky top nav; landscape, keyboard and 200% zoom cannot obscure controls. Desktop unchanged where already good. Acceptance: route inventory + screenshot/interaction matrix across desktop/portrait/landscape, 4xx/5xx/timeout/rapid toggle.

### D14 — P1: Help and final reconciliation (v5 §§25–31)

Unify source-of-truth Help/guide with actual shipped UI and runtime, not envisioned. `plans/workflow_state.md` and `plans/runtime_task.md` accurately reflect current HEAD/release/prod and owner-pending gates. Final report must enumerate each C/D ID with `implemented/tested/committed/deployed/live-verified` and exact evidence. No P0 in backlog to claim completion. Existing F10 pins are not acceptance.

## D. Phasing and dependencies — efficient continuation, not rerun

**Phase 0 (read-only):** C01–C10 + D01–D14 ledger, exact baseline, status. PM checks all v5 sections/acceptance IDs against ledger; missing ID = STOP. Architect resolves ONLY current unresolved design questions, no re-architecture of proven F1–F9.

**P0 correctness before cosmetics:** D01, D02, D03, D04, D06, D07, D08; focused reconciliation of C03A and C06A. D03/D04 must share Direct contracts and merge before combined tests. D06 affects memory/Experience/GraphRAG. D07 affects saving and all modules; freeze resolver/schema before UI.

**Runtime P1:** D05, D09, D10, D11 plus uncovered C01–C09 live/fix deltas. Parallel only with disjoint WRITE_SCOPE and stable shared schema. Do not let parallel UI Builder alter writer candidate that Reviewer currently evaluates.

**UI/report last:** D12 data semantics → widgets; D13 universal route audit; D14 final coverage. UI may prototype earlier but cannot be labelled shipped before authoritative data and runtime. Deploy by safe, reviewed waves and run focused prod acceptance for each.

**Stop rule:** not when 9 commits exist, not when all delegated F are marked green, not when a release version bumped. Stop only when source ledger has no uncovered ID, no failed/unknown mandatory P0, production candidate binding is known, and live proofs exist. Genuine owner-only visual judgment may remain `OWNER_VISUAL_PENDING` and must be explicitly distinguished from completed technical criteria. No fake human gate for Direct.

## E. Required completion artifacts

Create only under `plans/features/asap8-v6-remediation/`:
- `requirements-map.md` with all C/D IDs, v5 section, source hash, exact files/tests, code/live verdict, next owner.
- `forensic.md` claim vs HEAD/prod, dropped-item RCA and code path, no assumed causes.
- `architecture-decisions.md` only for genuine changes (schema, permissions, Direct tooling, Random master, scope).
- `tests-and-evidence.md` linked replay inputs/log summaries/screenshots, no raw secrets.
- Per-slice bounded report + Reviewer exact candidate verdict + DevOps exact deployed SHA/probe result.
- `owner-report.md`: compact summary of proven, failures, unresolved owner-only validation, rollback.

Before Builder starts, PM and Orchestrator must run *machine-checked* requirement coverage gate over C01–C10/D01–D14. При конфликте более поздние конкретные требования в этом v6.3 имеют приоритет над v6.1/v6.2. Отсутствующие архивные скриншоты не блокируют работу. Не выдавать гипотезу за доказанный RCA.

**Подтверждённые пользовательские симптомы, достаточные без иллюстраций:**
- Windows Telegram Desktop: нажатие web-кнопки fullscreen иногда переводит MiniApp в небольшое неудобное окно вместо заполнения монитора; нарушаются ожидаемые возможности закрытия/перемещения. Проверить на настоящем клиенте, не предполагая, что CSS управляет нативным окном.
- Android Telegram: в верхней нативной зоне уже есть элементы «Закрыть», сворачивание и `⋮`; web-кнопка fullscreen сейчас слишком крупная и расположена отдельным низким рядом. Её следует сделать компактной и максимально приблизить к native-зоне в пределах официальной safe area WebView.
- BotFather Main App в режиме `Launch Mode = Fullscreen`: учитывать исходный fullscreen на запуске, нельзя отправлять второй request без проверки и нельзя программно редактировать внешнюю настройку BotFather.
- Liquid Glass: текущий результат выглядит как размытый полупрозрачный фон; требуется читаемый стеклянный материал с оптическим изгибом подложки по краю линзы, светящейся кромкой, локальным бликом, сохранением тёмной палитры и без размытия контента. Подробный самодостаточный контракт описан в U08.

**Официальные контракты, которым реализация должна соответствовать:**
- Telegram Mini Apps: https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps — `requestFullscreen()`, `exitFullscreen()`, `isFullscreen`, `fullscreenChanged`, `fullscreenFailed`, `contentSafeAreaInset`, `safeAreaInset`, `setHeaderColor`, нативные Back/Settings controls.
- Telegram Web events: https://core.telegram.org/api/web-events — полноэкранные события и коды `UNSUPPORTED` / `ALREADY_FULLSCREEN`.
- Platform list: https://docs.telegram-mini-apps.com/platform/about — `android`, `ios`, `macos`, `tdesktop`, `weba`, `web` (не путать Windows Telegram Desktop с обычным браузером).
- Liquid Glass cross-engine caveats: https://github.com/Meapri/liquid-glass-web , https://github.com/dpawlikowski/liquid-glass — refraction arbitrary backdrop в Chromium через `backdrop-filter: url(#...)` не гарантирована в WebKit; для кроссплатформенной оптики требуется собственный/синхронизированный декоративный фон или хорошая слоистая fallback-имитация. Эти материалы — технические ориентиры, **не обязательные зависимости**.

**Обязательные принципы:**
- Строить работающий цикл, а не регистрировать абстрактный модуль. `enabled=true`, живой heartbeat, зелёные unit-тесты, запись `implemented` в реестре **не являются** выполнением бизнес-функции.
- Не подменять неработающее поведение новыми статусами и диаграммами. Сначала устранить разрывы source → event → processing → decision → output → feedback, затем отрисовать правдивую телеметрию.
- **Только один OpenCode workflow** (Orchestrator/Architect/PM/Builder/Reviewer/DevOps/Memory), существующие SQLite + PostgreSQL, не вводить новую самостоятельную очередь и не перестраивать проект без доказанной необходимости. Единственный human gate Architect — реальные неоднозначные архитектурные решения; для остальных продолжать до проверенного результата.
- Не уничтожать сообщения, память, архивные факты, истории, доказательства, стиль профиля, референсы и per-chat параметры. Не менять продакшен без существующих backup/rollback/feature-gates. Сохранять безопасность и права Telegram.
- Любой пункт можно признать уже сделанным **только после проверки актуального HEAD + runtime/тестов**. Не копировать код и не переписывать исправное. Все несделанные подпункты обязательны; `backlog` без одобрения владельца запрещён.
